engine.autoInstallHintAfter: . The first run downloads a few tens of MB.
engine.autoInstallHintBefore: This creates a separate environment inside Tavotto's own folder and installs matplotlib into it.
engine.autoInstallHintStrong: None of your existing Python environments are touched
engine.bundledHint: The common scientific stack (numpy / matplotlib / pandas / scipy / seaborn / Pillow) ships with Tavotto, so you do not need to install Python and the first render works offline.
engine.incompleteAfter: — please reinstall Tavotto. If antivirus software removed it, add Tavotto's install folder to the allowlist afterwards.
engine.incompleteHint: Layout, annotation and export are unaffected; only figure-element editing needs the rendering environment. Settings → “Environment diagnostics” can export a diagnostics bundle.
engine.missingBody: Figure-element editing needs a Python with matplotlib. Tavotto runs your own scripts, so the interpreter has to be able to import the libraries they use. Layout, annotation and export are unaffected.
engine.missingModuleBody: Tavotto bundles the common scientific stack (numpy / matplotlib / pandas / scipy / seaborn / Pillow). This script needs something else — point the rendering environment at the Python / Conda environment you normally run it in.
engine.missingModuleNoteBefore: Tavotto only launches it to render;
engine.missingModuleNoteStrong: nothing is ever installed into it
engine.noPythonAfter: (or Anaconda) first, then come back here.
engine.noPythonBefore: No usable Python was found on this machine. Install
engine.pathPlaceholder: /path/to/python, or the python inside a conda environment
engine.useOtherHintAfter: — it only launches it to render.
engine.useOtherHintBefore: Switch to your own environment when a script needs packages the bundled one lacks (rdkit, astropy…). Apply with the field empty to go back to the default. Tavotto
engine.useOtherHintStrong: never modifies the environment you choose
